# Feazto

> Feazto is an upcoming regional food-tech ecosystem connecting consumers with authentic home kitchens, dedicated CareFe cloud kitchens, and verified Book-a-Cook on-demand culinary professionals.

## Overview
- **Name**: Feazto
- **Tagline**: Food, Culture, Connect
- **Website**: https://feazto.com/
- **Status**: Coming Soon (Pre-Launch)
- **Contact**: feazto26@gmail.com

## Core Service Concepts
1. **Regional Food Delivery**: A culinary discovery experience connecting customers with authentic regional cuisines, local food creators, and home-style cooking.
2. **CareFe**: A dedicated cloud-kitchen concept designed to bring curated regional food concepts to life.
3. **Book-a-Cook**: An on-demand culinary service enabling customers to book verified cooks for everyday meals, gatherings, and events.
4. **Fiso AI**: An upcoming AI-assisted food discovery experience providing personalized dish recommendations and culinary search.

## Brand Positioning
Feazto celebrates regional culinary culture, heritage, and the feeling of home through modern, trustworthy food technology.
